title: Treasury of Year-Round Preschool Activities (Teacher Created Materials, ©2000)
description: A comprehensive 120-page year-round preschool activity book organized by month (September–August), with 4 weekly themed units per month. Each unit includes 5 days of structured activities: sharing time discussions, movement activities, themed lessons with reproducible worksheets, arts & crafts projects, and cooking experiences. Includes monthly planning calendars, food supply lists, activity supply lists, cooking rules, and a skills index.

layout.notes: Two-page spreads: left page is typically a worksheet/activity page, right page is the next day's lesson plan or another worksheet. Lesson plan pages are text-heavy with embedded illustrations. Worksheet pages have bold titles, simple instructions, and large illustration areas for young children.

unmappedSkills.description: Scissor skills — cutting along lines, cutting out shapes for bracelets and crafts
Coloring exercises integrated into most worksheet pages
Tracing circles, triangles, and other shapes on themed pages
Seasonal awareness woven through monthly themes (winter clothing, spring flowers, summer fruits)
Animals by season — owls, squirrels (Nov), reindeer (Dec), honeybees (Apr), caterpillars/butterflies (Apr)
Implicit in sharing time and social themes
Halloween, Thanksgiving, Hanukkah, Kwanzaa, Valentine's Day, Presidents' Day, Easter, St. Patrick's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Fourth of July
Gluing cotton to cloud shapes, glitter to stars, tissue paper to trees
Weekly cooking experiences: cookie decorating, pudding, toast, fruit arrangements
Movement activities with songs and fingerplays each week ('Here Is the Beehive', 'Twinkle Twinkle')
Same/different exercises (matching ghosts, matching dinosaurs), spotting odd-one-out
Pattern recognition in several worksheets (winter patterns cut & paste)

difficulty.notes: Designed for preschool/pre-K (ages 3-5). Each weekly unit scaffolds heavily with teacher-directed sharing time before independent worksheet work. Activities range from simple coloring to cutting-and-pasting to tracing letters/numbers.

characters: seasonal animals (owls, squirrels, reindeer, bees, butterflies)
appealDrivers: large simple illustrations suitable for coloring
hands-on crafts and cooking to break up worksheet pages

printFormat.notes: Entire book is B&W. Most worksheet pages are landscape (two per spread). Some activity pages are portrait. All designed for easy photocopying.

gaps.description: Song/fingerplay cards with illustrated actions — like 'Here Is the Beehive' with hand motions. Not a printable worksheet but a reference card for the teacher/parent.
Simple illustrated cooking recipe for preschoolers with numbered steps and safety callouts. Weekly feature in this book.
Blank monthly calendar grid with themed header illustrations. Used for weather charting, daily planning, schedule tracking.
Draw-lines-to-match activity (e.g., matching ghosts, matching uppercase to lowercase letters). Different from flash cards — it's a single worksheet with two columns to connect.
Rows of similar images where child marks which is different. Visual discrimination exercise.
Classify items into categories (hot/cold, up/down). Cut-out images placed into labeled zones.

curriculumStructure.shapeSequence: One shape per month (circle, triangle, rectangle, star, etc.)

notes: This is a full year-round curriculum disguised as an activity book. The real value isn't any single worksheet — it's the integrated weekly rhythm: discuss → move → practice → create → cook. That 5-day loop is a powerful pattern for Homa's weekly planner. The B&W clip-art style is dated (2000) but the pedagogical structure is solid. Key insight: every theme connects to a letter, number, shape, AND color — that multi-strand threading through seasonal themes is what makes it work as a curriculum, not just a worksheet collection.
